5.1 A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.

findings.why: Moving HB-620 from Fonderia Dora (SUP-D) to Fonderia Pellice (SUP-H) is a change of source. HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y, a Nordhavn program. CSR-NOR-R2 5.1 therefore requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment. No Nordhavn approval is in the documents. The internal approval APR-011 does not replace it. Aurelia requirements do not apply because HB-620 has no Aurelia program.
